stages.label: Chapter 1 · Leonida Keys
stages.summary: Finish Gone Fishing and Chapter 1, beat Cal at fishing, and do not leave Ch. 1 without Lucia's balcony meditation[1][2].
stages.focus: Keep manual save slots at chapter start & end (no mission replay)[1].

stages.label: Chapter 2 · Dual Free-Roam
stages.summary: Clear Breakfast Run and Coffee Break to unlock dual-character switching, partner robberies, and Combat Focus cleanup[1][2].
stages.focus: Open-world meditations now count twice (Jason + Lucia)[1][2].

stages.label: Chapter 3 · Cartel & Strangers
stages.summary: Complete The Cartel Heist and advance purple Stranger strands across Leonida as multi-day callbacks arrive[1][4].
stages.focus: Track 8 full stranger strands; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy & Tyrone[4].

stages.label: Chapter 4 · Vice City Heists
stages.summary: Finish Child's Play, Headliners, and VCIA Takedown, then hit VCIA departure, stealth jewelry, and 5 Bank Vaults[1][3].
stages.focus: Rotate saves before major vaults and late-chapter transitions[1].

stages.label: Chapter 5 · Finale & Economy
stages.summary: Clear Operation Savage Glory and the finale, clear 9 gang ops, launder $250k Marked Bills, buy 8 garages, register 10 rides[1][2].
stages.focus: Unlocks the in-game 100% Completion Checklist in Stats[1].

stages.label: Post-Game Cleanup & Collectibles
stages.summary: Sweep 250 Stunts, 42 Shooting Range golds, 14 Top Fun drones, 20 races, 100 WAiNK spots, 3 card sets, 52 areas, and 50 challenges[1][3].
stages.focus: Check launch-unconfirmed secret triggers as guides verify them[2][3].

stages.label: 100% Completion & Platinum
stages.summary: Close out A Long Road (200/557 vehicles, 100/255 animals studied, 70/80 challenges, 15/18 meditations) to pop Vice Got a Price![1][3].
stages.focus: Zero online trophies; cheats stay off for the entire run[1][2].

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Never permanently locked unless you miss a chapter-bound prerequisite without a backup save; keep rotating saves across all 15 manual slots[1][2].
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically once every one of the other 54 single-player PS5 trophies is earned[1][3]. All 55 trophies are offline with no multiplayer or difficulty requirements, though activating cheats disables trophy unlocks and saving[1][2].
steps: Finish Chapters 1–5 (~60–80h) while rotating manual saves and hitting Chapter 1's balcony meditation[1][2].
Complete all side strands, robberies, collectibles, and activity milestones in post-story free-roam[1][3].
Reach 100% Completion for A Long Road to trigger the Platinum[1][3].

sources.backs: ~200h platinum estimate, 4/10 difficulty, 0 online, 15 save slots, cheats disable trophies.
Single-player only requirement, no difficulty trophies, no mission gold-medal requirement.
Official PS5 Platinum name, verbatim description, and 55-trophy total.

trophies.guide: Unlocks upon finishing Gone Fishing, the opening Chapter 1 story mission introducing Leonida's basics[1][3]. No difficulty setting or mission medal rank affects the unlock[1][2].
steps: Start a fresh campaign without enabling any cheat codes[1][2].
Follow the main objective prompts through Gone Fishing until the mission complete banner pops[1][3].

sources.backs: Story-bound Chapter 1 unlock and no difficulty/medal requirement.

steps: Create a manual Chapter 1 start save and keep it untouched[1].
After Down to Earth, complete Lucia's balcony meditation so Positive Mental Attitude stays safe[1][2].
Finish the remaining Chapter 1 main story missions to unlock the trophy[1][3].

sources.backs: Chapter 1 story progression and manual save rotation advice.
Chapter 1 exclusive balcony meditation check before advancing.

steps: Create a dedicated Chapter 2 start save slot[1].
Play through Chapter 2's main story chain, including Breakfast Run and Coffee Break[1][2].
Complete the Chapter 2 finale to earn the trophy[1][3].

Complete all Chapter 3 main missions through The Cartel Heist[1][2].

trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically by completing VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4[1][2]. Keep a manual save before late-chapter set pieces since mission replay is absent[1].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms nothing on the 100% Completion Checklist is permanently missable; everything can be finished post-story[1].
trophies.guide: Complete the in-game 100% checklist unlocked after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (prior progress counts retroactively)[1]. Like RDR2, the checklist is lenient (~60% true game completion): scan 200/557 vehicles via WAiNK, study 100/255 animals with binoculars, finish 70/80 challenges, 15/18 meditations, Bret's 15 hunting quests, robberies, shooting ranges, and drone races[1][2].
steps: Finish the story to reveal Progress > Stats > 100% Completion[1].
Knock out mandatory full subsets: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, and Bret's 15 hunting quests[1].
Hit partial thresholds: 200 vehicles scanned (WAiNK), 100 animals studied, 70/80 challenges, and 15/18 meditations[1][2].

sources.backs: 100% menu path, retroactive tracking, lenient thresholds (200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70/80 challenges, 15/18 meditations), zero missables.
Post-story checklist cleanup and ~200h platinum pacing.
Official Gold grade and verbatim 100% Completion requirement.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Available throughout open-world free-roam; cannot be missed[1].
trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts across Leonida's ramps, bridges, rooftops, and waterways[1][3]. Fast bikes and upgraded sports cars make landing clean approaches much faster, and stunts also feed your 100% Completion checklist[1][2].
steps: Use a fast agile bike or upgraded sports car for reliable approach speed and landing control[1].
Sweep regions systematically in free-roam so you do not double-check completed stunt spots[1][2].
Track running progress via the in-game Progress stats until all 250 register[1][3].

sources.backs: Free-roam availability and overlap with 100% completion cleanup.
Silver activity milestone scope.
Official Silver grade and 250-stunt PSN target count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: All 9 activity categories remain playable in post-story free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 distinct activity types at least once across Leonida: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing an arcade/video game, racing, and performing a stunt[1][2]. Most happen naturally while pursuing dedicated activity trophies[1].
steps: Clear the natural trophy overlaps first: fishing (Cal), hunting (Bret), shooting range, racing, arcade, and a stunt[1].
Visit the remaining pastime icons on the map: golf, pool, and basketball[1].
Complete one round or attempt of each until all 9/9 register on PSN's tracker[1][2].

sources.backs: Exact 9 activity categories (fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video game, racing, stunt).
Official Bronze grade and 9-activity PSN counter.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: All 42 range trials stay accessible in free-roam and count toward 100% Completion[1].
trophies.guide: Score a Gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges across Leonida's ranges[1][3]. Upgraded weapon attachments (extended mags, scopes, recoil grips) and practiced headshots make tight accuracy timers manageable[1][2].
steps: Upgrade weapon magazines and handling mods before grinding high-tier range tiers[1].
Clear each weapon class to Gold across every shooting range venue[1][3].
Confirm 42/42 Gold medals in your stats; full completion also feeds A Long Road[1].

sources.backs: 42 Shooting Range challenges required for both trophy and 100% checklist.
Skill ceiling context within 4/10 platinum rating.
Official Silver grade and 42-challenge PSN target.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: All 14 drone race locations stay open in free-roam and are required for 100% Completion[1].
trophies.guide: Finish first in a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 Leonida locations[1][2]. Keep your drone smooth through checkpoint rings rather than over-correcting pitch, and retry tight indoor courses until you memorize gate lines[1].
steps: Locate all 14 Top Fun Drone Race markers across Leonida's regions[1][2].
Place 1st at each location; use one practice lap to learn sharp gate turns[1].
Verify 14/14 wins, which also satisfies the Drone Races subset for 100% Completion[1].

sources.backs: 14 drone race venues and mandatory overlap with 100% checklist.
Official Bronze grade and 14-location PSN count.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: All open-world race events remain repeatable in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Place first in 20 distinct races across Leonida (street, off-road, water, or air events—replaying the same race does not stack)[1][2]. Invest in engine, turbo, and brake upgrades for your primary race classes first[1].
steps: Upgrade one top-tier vehicle per race discipline (street, off-road, water)[1].
Enter and win 20 unique race courses across the map[1][2].
Check map icons for checkmark badges so you only run uncompleted courses[1].

sources.backs: Free-roam race progression and 100% overlap.
Official Bronze grade and 20-different-races PSN target.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Can be challenged early in Leonida Keys and remains repeatable afterward[1][3].
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a head-to-head fishing challenge[1][2]. Cast near visible surface ripples, ease line tension when a fish thrashes, and reel firmly during calm intervals to beat Cal's total catch[1][3].
steps: Meet Cal at his fishing spot in the Leonida Keys and accept the fishing challenge[1][3].
Target active ripples, manage line tension when fish pull, and land heavier catches before time runs out[1].
Finish ahead of Cal's score to unlock the trophy and check off fishing for Master of None[1][2].

sources.backs: Early fishing activity overlap with Master of None.
Official Bronze grade and verbatim Cal challenge description.
Early Leonida Keys availability and free-roam repeatability.

steps: Find an arcade venue, bar, or safehouse cabinet offering a playable minigame[1][2].
Play through all stages or reach the finish condition to unlock the trophy[1][2].

steps: Locate Andy's opening purple Stranger icon and finish his introductory mission[1][2].
Advance in-game time between jobs until Andy's follow-up markers appear[1][2].
Complete Andy's finale to pop the trophy and advance Strangers & Freaks[1][3].

Andy's Cellerica stranger strand placement.

Finish each diving/shipwreck follow-up after in-game cooldown texts arrive[1][2].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: WATCH / POSSIBLY MISSABLE: More than 8 strands exist and PowerPyx notes most remain in free-roam, but some strands require multi-day chapter callbacks and GTA VI has no mission replay—start purple icons as they appear and keep chapter saves[1][2].
trophies.guide: Finish 8 complete Stranger questlines across Leonida[1][3]. Completing the 5 trophy-bearing strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus 3 others (such as Bret Vogel, Kirk, Kyle, Moses, Yago, Yasmani, or Pilot Pete) gets you to 8/8[1][2]. Wait several in-game days or advance a chapter when waiting for a character's next callback[1][2].
steps: Prioritize the 5 trophy-linked strands first: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone[1][2].
Complete 3 additional Leonida stranger strands (e.g., Bret Vogel, Kirk, Kyle, Moses, or Pilot Pete)[2].
Sleep or progress chapters whenever a strand pauses for a follow-up call or text[1][2].

sources.backs: More than 8 strands exist, multi-day callback pacing, and no mission replay caution.
Named stranger list (Andy, Billy, Bret Vogel, Kirk, Kyle, Moses, Yago, Yasmani, Pilot Pete).
Official Silver grade and 8-strand PSN target.

steps: Trigger Randy's first purple Stranger marker and complete his opening request[1].
Deliver his follow-up Wish List objectives as new messages arrive[1][2].
Finish Randy's final mission to pop the trophy[1][2].

steps: Find Tyrone's opening purple Stranger icon linked to Kitty Litter Labs[1][2].
Complete each stage as Tyrone texts you after in-game days pass[1].
Finish Tyrone's closing mission to unlock the trophy[1][3].

sources.backs: Stranger callback pacing and Strangers & Freaks progress.
Tyrone's Kitty Litter Labs strand context.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — Spot #1 on Jason's backyard balcony is exclusive to Chapter 1 right after Down to Earth. Missing it requires an earlier manual save or a fresh run because GTA VI has no mission replay[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: Launch guides confirm Spot #1 adds +1 to your 18/18 total and urge doing it in Chapter 1 immediately; whether any late-game patch adds a fallback is unverified at launch[1][2].
trophies.guide: Complete all 18 meditations across 10 Leonida locations[1][2]. Open-world purple meditation icons count twice because both Jason and Lucia can meditate at each spot separately after Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks dual-character free-roam[1][2]. Track exact progress in-game under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations (15/18 suffices for 100% Completion, while all 18/18 are required for this trophy)[1][2].
steps: CHAPTER 1 PRIORITY: After Down to Earth, sleep until morning at Jason's house, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the backyard balcony, focus with L2, and choose Accept[1][2].
Unlock dual-character switching in Chapter 2 via Coffee Break[1][2].

Visit the remaining 9 open-world Leonida meditation locations (Mariana, Kelly, Lummox, and Leonard counties) and meditate with both Jason and Lucia where available until Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations reads 18/18[1][2].

sources.backs: 18 meditations across 10 spots, Ch.1 balcony prompt after Down to Earth (L2 + Accept), dual-protagonist counts after Coffee Break, exact menu path, 15/18 vs 18/18.
Chapter 1 balcony missable alert, no mission replay warning, and manual chapter save strategy.
Official PS5 Bronze grade, visible status, and 18-count tracker.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Bret Vogel's 15 hunting quests remain available in post-story free-roam and count toward 100% Completion[1].
trophies.guide: Track and take down a unique legendary-style animal for hunter Bret Vogel[1][3]. Bret's 15 hunting quests are also a mandatory full subset for A Long Road, so clearing his hunts advances both goals[1].
steps: Meet Bret Vogel to start his Leonida hunting questline[1][2].
Track clues to a unique animal target, use binoculars to study it for 100% stats first, then hunt it cleanly[1].
Complete the hunt for Bret to pop the trophy[1][3].

sources.backs: Bret's 15 hunting quests mandatory for 100% and binocular study tip.
Bret Vogel stranger strand details.
Official hidden Bronze grade and verbatim description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Collectible Cards stay in the open world throughout post-story free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Collect every card in 3 distinct Collectible Card sets scattered around Leonida's interiors, landmarks, and side streets[1][2]. Focus on finishing 3 specific sets rather than grabbing random singles so your progress closes out cleanly[1].
steps: Open Progress > Collections to pick 3 specific card sets you already have partial progress on[1].
Sweep all remaining card locations for those 3 sets during post-story free-roam[1][2].
Confirm 3/3 completed sets to trigger this Silver trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: Free-roam collectible cleanup and Collections menu tracking.
Official Silver grade and 3-set PSN count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: WAiNK check-in locations stay accessible throughout free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Pull out your phone and use the in-game WAiNK app at 100 unique locations, landmarks, or businesses across Leonida[1][2]. Build the habit while exploring all 52 map zones and scanning 200 vehicles for 100% Completion[1].
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone whenever you arrive at a new landmark, venue, or storefront[1][2].
Pair WAiNK check-ins with your 52-area map sweep (The Goodtime State) and vehicle scans[1].
Reach 100 unique WAiNK locations to earn the Silver trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: WAiNK app mechanics and synergy with 100% vehicle scanning.
Official Silver grade and 100-location PSN target.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: All 80 challenges across 8 categories remain completable in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of Leonida's 80 total Challenges spread across 8 categories[1][2]. Keep going to 70/80 afterward because A Long Road requires 70 challenges while still letting you skip the 10 hardest ones[1].
steps: Review all 8 Challenge categories in your Progress menu early so passive actions count during the story[1].
Finish the 50 fastest challenges to unlock One Last Thing[1][2].
Push to 70/80 challenges (skipping the 10 toughest) for 100% Completion[1].

sources.backs: 80 challenges across 8 categories; 50 for trophy, 70 for 100% (10 skippable).
Official Bronze grade and 50-challenge PSN target.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable anytime in dual-protagonist free-roam from Chapter 2 onward[1][2].
trophies.guide: Trigger a 4-star Wanted Level while riding or hanging out with your partner (Jason and Lucia together), then break police line-of-sight until the heat clears completely[1][3]. Combines cleanly with Retail Therapy[1].
steps: Pair up Jason and Lucia in free-roam after Chapter 2's Coffee Break[1][2].
Escalate your Wanted Level to 4 stars—either via back-to-back shop robberies or a shootout near a tunnel/garage getaway[1].
Break sightlines in an alley, parking structure, or off-road cover until all 4 stars clear[1][3].

sources.backs: Dual-protagonist free-roam pairing and Retail Therapy synergy.
Chapter 2 dual-character free-roam unlock.
Official Bronze grade and verbatim 4-star escape requirement.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable anytime Jason and Lucia can free-roam together[1][2].
trophies.guide: Plot a tight loop of 3 nearby convenience stores or shops, pair up Jason and Lucia, and rob all 3 in a single unbroken Wanted Level chain[1][3]. Keep police engaged loosely between stops so your stars never drop to zero before Shop #3[1].
steps: Scout 3 close-together shops on a single Vice City corridor and park a fast 4-door getaway outside[1].
Rob Shop #1 with your partner to spark a Wanted Level, then drive straight to Shop #2 while stars stay active[1][3].
Hit Shop #3 before losing your Wanted Level; optionally escalate to 4 stars and escape for Hot Together[1][3].

sources.backs: Robberies overlap with 100% completion and Hot Together combo.
Dual-character free-roam setup.
Official Bronze grade and 3-shop back-to-back PSN target.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Over 557 total vehicles (277 base models) exist across free-roam; cannot be missed[1].
trophies.guide: Discover 100 unique vehicles across Leonida by hopping into or scanning new rides with the WAiNK app[1][2]. You will sail past 100 naturally because A Long Road requires scanning 200 out of 557 vehicles[1].
steps: Scan unfamiliar parked and passing cars with your WAiNK app as you play through the story[1].
Check highway rest stops, Vice City boulevards, marinas, and airfields for unique vehicle classes[1].
Hit 100/100 for this trophy and continue to 200 for 100% Completion[1][2].

sources.backs: 557 total vehicles (277 base models) and 200 WAiNK scans required for 100%.
Official Bronze grade and 100-vehicle PSN count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Can be attempted during any gunfight, gang raid, or police shootout in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Eliminate 5 hostile targets during a single activation of Combat Focus[1][2]. Wait until your Combat Focus bar is full, equip a high-capacity rifle or SMG, and trigger it when 5+ enemies cluster at a gang operation[1].
steps: Fill your Combat Focus meter and load a high-capacity rifle or pistol with clean headshot damage[1].
Approach a crowded gang illegal operation or roadblock with at least 5 enemies in view[1].
Activate Combat Focus and chain 5 rapid headshots before the bar expires[1][2].

sources.backs: Free-roam combat availability and gang operation setup.
Official Bronze grade and 5-enemy single-use requirement.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Vice City International Airport (VCIA) stays accessible in free-roam[1][3].
trophies.guide: Breach the restricted tarmac at Vice City International Airport (VCIA), commandeer an aircraft without authorization, and lift off into an unscheduled departure[1][2][3].
steps: Drive to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and breach a runway gate or ramp jump onto the tarmac[1][3].
Board a parked jet or propeller plane on the runway under police pursuit[3].
Throttle down the runway and lift off cleanly to unlock the trophy[2][3].

sources.backs: Free-roam airport accessibility.
Official hidden Bronze name and VCIA description.
Unauthorized VCIA aircraft departure requirement.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Military base Rhino spawns stay accessible in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Infiltrate a military installation—such as Mile Zero Air Station—and steal/climb inside a Rhino tank[1][2]. Equip heavy body armor and approach fast in an armored ride to reach the tank bay before base defenses shred you[1].
steps: Save manually and equip full armor before heading to Mile Zero Air Station[1].
Breach the perimeter and rush straight to a parked Rhino tank on the tarmac[1].
Board the Rhino tank to pop the hidden trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: Mile Zero Air Station Rhino tank theft method.
Official hidden Bronze grade and verbatim description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Jewelry store robberies remain repeatable in open-world free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Hit a jewelry store cleanly without tripping alarms or letting guards or cameras spot you[1][2]. Scout camera arcs before entering, use silenced gear or stealth takedowns, grab the display cases, and slip out quietly[1].
steps: Save outside a Vice City jewelry store and scout its entrances, cameras, and guard routes[1].
Disable or avoid cameras and neutralize guards silently so no alarm sounds[1].
Loot the cases and exit undetected to unlock the trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: Robbery mechanics and free-roam repeatability.
Official Bronze grade and undetected jewelry robbery description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Bank vaults remain open for free-roam heists and count toward 100% robberies[1].
trophies.guide: Crack and loot 5 separate Bank Vaults across Leonida and successfully lose the ensuing police chase each time[1][3]. Unlike convenience stores, vaults demand full armor, heavy weapons, breaching tools, and a pre-staged getaway car[1][2].
steps: Stock full armor, breaching gear, and park a fast getaway vehicle facing the exit before entering each bank[1].
Breach the vault, grab the cash, and fight out to your getaway car[1][3].
Lose your Wanted Level completely after each of the 5 distinct bank vaults to claim this Silver trophy[1][3].

sources.backs: Robberies requirement for 100% completion and free-roam access.
Silver crime tier overview.
Official Silver grade and 5-vault PSN count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Armored Trucks spawn dynamically throughout free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Intercept a roaming Armored Truck in Leonida, crack its rear doors, grab the cash haul, and clear your Wanted Level[1][2]. Sticky explosives or focused gunfire on the rear lock mechanism pop the doors open quickly[1].
steps: Watch for dynamic Armored Truck icons along major Vice City and highway routes[1].
Block the truck, take out the guards, and breach the rear doors to collect the loot[1][2].
Evade police until your Wanted Level disappears to pop the trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: Dynamic free-roam robbery encounter and 100% synergy.
Official Bronze grade and verbatim Armored Truck description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: All 52 Leonida areas can be unfogged anytime in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Visit and reveal all 52 named areas across the state of Leonida[1][2]. Most unlock organically during the story and collectibles sweep; fly a helicopter or fast jet over the remaining coastal islands, swamps, and northern counties to clear the last few[1].
steps: Play through Chapters 1–5 and collectible sweeps to discover the majority of Leonida naturally[1].
Grab a helicopter or aircraft and fly low over any fogged pockets, keys, and northern backcountry zones[1].
Reach 52/52 discovered areas to unlock the trophy[1][2].

sources.backs: Free-roam exploration cleanup across Leonida's counties.
Official Bronze grade and 52-area PSN counter.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Gang illegal operations stay available across Leonida in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Scout and successfully raid at least 1 illegal operation (drug labs, chop shops, stash houses, or smuggling hubs) run by each of Leonida's 9 distinct gangs[1][2]. Keep track of which gang turf you have hit so none of the 9 are skipped[1].
steps: Note all 9 gang territories across Leonida as they open through the campaign and side intel[1][2].
Infiltrate or assault one illegal enterprise per gang, grab the stash, and escape[1][2].
Verify all 9/9 gangs are checked off on the PSN tracker[2].

sources.backs: Robbery cleanup and free-roam gang hub access.
Official Bronze grade and 9-gang PSN count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Free-roam Ocean Beach easter egg; no missable flag reported at launch[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — Exact Ocean Beach hotel/bar seat and time-of-day trigger are still being verified by launch guides; official PSN text confirms the Ocean Beach cocktail action[1][2].
trophies.guide: A hidden nod to Vice City's iconic opening beach strip: visit Ocean Beach and order/drink a cocktail at a beachfront hotel or balcony bar overlooking the water[1][2]. Because launch guides are still pinning down the exact venue trigger, check Ocean Beach's signature beachfront terrace bars in free-roam[1][2].
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in Vice City during free-roam[1][2].
Visit beachfront hotel bars and terrace lounges overlooking the ocean and order a cocktail[1][2].
Watch for community confirmation of the exact seat/balcony spot if the prompt does not pop immediately[1][2].

sources.backs: Launch-window verification status and Vice City Ocean Beach callback.
Official hidden Bronze title (with ellipsis) and verbatim Ocean Beach description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Open-world stunt/showroom interaction; no missable window reported[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — The exact Vice City/Leonida dealership and whether a specific classic car or upper-floor window is required is awaiting launch-guide confirmation[1][2].
trophies.guide: Steal a display vehicle inside a Leonida car dealership and smash straight through its plate-glass showroom window onto the street in classic GTA style[1][2]. Launch guides are still confirming which specific dealership showroom triggers the pop[1][2].
steps: Locate a walk-in glass-fronted vehicle showroom in Vice City during free-roam[1][2].
Get inside a showroom display car (preferably a classic sports model) and accelerate directly through the front glass[1][2].
Check updated launch guides if a specific dealership name or upper-level jump is required[1][2].

sources.backs: Launch-status tracking for cryptic showroom smash trigger.
Official hidden Bronze grade and verbatim showroom description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: Accessible in free-roam at the Kolt & Associates' alley[1][3].
trophies.guide: A playful callback to GTA IV: locate the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and play through a bowling session (or score a clean follow-through strike/frame)[1][3]. Keep an eye on Kolt & Associates' signage in Leonida's commercial district[1][3].
steps: Locate the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley on the map during free-roam[1][3].
Start a game of bowling (try both solo and partner hangout if needed) and complete your frames cleanly[1][3].

sources.backs: Free-roam accessibility across Leonida venues.
GTA IV bowling callback context and free-roam access.
Official hidden Bronze title (curly apostrophe) and Kolt & Associates' description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Dual-protagonist workout/gym interaction; keep chapter saves if unsure of trigger timing[2][3].
trophies.guide: A cryptic hidden trophy referencing Jason and Lucia's partnership and 'mass appeal' (widely linked to hitting a gym/weightlifting personal best together as partners)[2][3]. Visit a Leonida gym/workout bench with both protagonists paired up to trigger the milestone[2][3].
steps: Pair up Jason and Lucia in free-roam after Chapter 2[1][2].
Visit an outdoor beach gym or indoor fitness bench and push a weightlifting/workout personal best together[2][3].

sources.backs: Dual-protagonist free-roam unlock from Chapter 2.
Dual-protagonist activity context and cryptic hidden status.
Official hidden Bronze grade and verbatim description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Cumulative PSN counter tracked to 500 across story and open-world interactions[1][2].
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a cumulative counter of 500 choices or interactive moral/dialogue decisions made across Leonida[1][2]. Engage consistently with ambient encounter prompts, dialogue responses, and mission choices rather than ignoring random events so the counter fills naturally[1][2].
steps: Respond actively to NPC dialogue prompts, random encounters, and contextual choices throughout Chapters 1–5[1][2].
Monitor the 500-count tracker on PS5's Trophy Progress card until it completes[2].

sources.backs: Narrative and interactive choice tracking context.
Official hidden Bronze grade and 500-count PSN tracker.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: No permanent lockout reported; keep chapter saves until launch guides verify the exact retry condition[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — The exact failure/retry or mishap event required for 'Second time's the charm' is still being pinned down by launch guides[2][3].
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy referencing Jason's trailer line ('Bad luck, I guess') with the official hint 'Second time's the charm.'[2][3] Early guides point toward failing and retrying a specific encounter, stunt, or escape scenario—check updated launch notes once exact reproduction steps lock in[2][3].
steps: Keep a clean set of rotating manual saves across chapters in case a specific scenario is involved[1].
Check launch-guide verification for the exact 'second try' trigger before wrapping up Stage 6 cleanup[2][3].

sources.backs: Manual save precaution across 15 slots.
Launch-unconfirmed status and retry-scenario clue.
Official hidden Bronze title and verbatim hint.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Open-world paranormal/UFO easter egg; no missable window reported[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — Exact Leonida coordinates, weather, and time-of-night spawn rules for this unexplained/paranormal encounter are still being confirmed at launch[1][2].
trophies.guide: An X-Files-style hidden easter egg awarded for witnessing a bizarre, unexplained, or paranormal event in Leonida[1][2]. Like previous Rockstar UFO/ghost sightings, it likely ties to a remote swamp, mountain peak, or late-night weather window currently being mapped by the community[1][2].
steps: Explore remote Leonida backcountry, swamps, and high peaks during late-night or stormy hours[1][2].
Check confirmed coordinates once community easter-egg hunters lock down the exact spawn window[1][2].

sources.backs: Paranormal/UFO easter egg classification and launch-unconfirmed status.
Official hidden Bronze grade and verbatim description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Free-roam vehicle melee combat trick; repeatable anytime[1][2].
trophies.unconfirmedNote: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — Official text confirms a melee drive-by knockdown, while exact target count (single strike vs multi-target sweep) and bike/car eligibility are still being confirmed at launch[1][2].
trophies.guide: Knock enemies or pedestrians flying with a melee weapon swing performed while riding or driving a vehicle (such as a motorcycle melee drive-by)[1][2]. Launch guides are still confirming whether one strike pops it or if a chain/group knockdown is required[1][2].
steps: Hop on a motorcycle with a melee weapon equipped (bat, pipe, or blunt weapon)[1][2].
Use the vehicle melee-swing control while riding past clustered targets to bowl them over[1][2].
Retry against a tight group if a single knockdown does not trigger the trophy immediately[1][2].

sources.backs: Melee drive-by classification and launch verification status.
Official hidden Bronze name and verbatim description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Marked-bill robberies and laundering contacts stay active in post-story free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Accumulate $250,000 in clean payouts by delivering Marked Bills from robberies, bank vaults, and gang operations to your laundering contacts[1][2]. Pursuing Maximum Withdrawal (5 Bank Vaults) and Pest Control (9 gang ops) supplies plenty of marked cash[1].
steps: Gather Marked Bills from Bank Vaults, Armored Trucks, and gang Illegal Operations[1].
Route your marked cash through laundering contacts rather than sitting on dirty bills[1][2].
Continue until $250,000 in laundered earnings registers on your tracker[2].

sources.backs: Robbery income loop and post-story availability.
Official Bronze grade and $250,000 PSN count.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: All Leonida retail, weapon, clothing, and vehicle shops remain open in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across Leonida's retail stores—weapon upgrades, clothing, custom vehicle mods, and gear[1][2]. This pops effortlessly during Stage 5–6 as you upgrade race cars and buy range weapons[1].
steps: Invest in weapon mods for The Shootist and performance upgrades for Earn Cash, Not Kudos[1].
Top off any remaining balance with outfits or accessories across shops until $100,000 is spent[1][2].

sources.backs: Natural overlap with weapon and vehicle upgrades.
Official Bronze grade and $100,000 shop spend target.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: All 8 garage properties remain purchasable in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Buy every one of Leonida's 8 garage properties[1][2]. Wait until post-heist payouts and Marked Bill laundering fill your bankroll in Stage 5 so you can purchase all 8 garages without grinding cash separately[1].
steps: Build funds through Chapter 3–5 heists and $250,000 in laundered Marked Bills[1].
Locate all 8 garage real-estate listings across Leonida and purchase each one[1][2].
Confirm 8/8 owned garages to pop the trophy[2].

sources.backs: Late-game cash flow and free-roam property access.
Official Bronze grade and 8-garage PSN target.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Vehicle registration via the Scooter Bros app stays available in free-roam[1].
trophies.guide: Store and register 10 different vehicles to your in-game Scooter Bros app for on-demand delivery across Leonida[1][2]. Owning garage slots from Little Boxes makes rotating and registering 10 rides quick and painless[1].
steps: Purchase garage space as you progress toward Little Boxes[1].
Register 10 unique vehicles inside the Scooter Bros phone app[1][2].
Verify 10/10 registered rides to unlock the trophy[2].

sources.backs: Garage ownership synergy and free-roam completion.
Official Bronze grade and 10-vehicle Scooter Bros count.
